title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Georgetown University
description: Ten food-forward Georgetown destinations with publicly posted current evening hours, ranging from campus-adjacent Wisconsin Avenue counters to sit-down options.

cards.title: George's King of Falafel & Cheesesteak
cards.subtitle: 1205 28th St NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Walk to 28th Street for a late meal; confirm the day’s closing time before leaving, since posted service extends later on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown restaurant with food service listed as late as 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: George's official site lists hours of noon–2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, noon–3 a.m. Thursday, and noon–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: George's — Our Story and Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Wed noon–2 a.m.; Thu noon–3 a.m.; Fri–Sat noon–4 a.m. Dine-in, carryout, and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Andy's Pizza Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1065 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the Wisconsin Avenue location for pizza after an evening on campus; its official page lists midnight closes most nights and 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Wisconsin Avenue pizza counter with midnight weekday and 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Andy's official Georgetown page lists 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–midnight; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–2 a.m.

cards.title: 90 Second Pizza Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1077 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Head to Wisconsin and M for a late pizza stop; the official location listing posts 2 a.m. closes Sunday through Thursday and 3 a.m. weekends.
cards.short_summary: A stone-baked pizza shop across from Georgetown Park with 2–3 a.m. posted closes.
cards.evidence_claim: 90 Second Pizza’s official site lists Georgetown hours of 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: 90 Second Pizza — Georgetown Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted Georgetown hours: Sun–Thu 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; Fri–Sat 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: Manny & Olga's Pizza Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1641 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Continue north on Wisconsin Avenue for pizza, pasta, or wings; check the posted schedule, which lists 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Wisconsin Avenue pizzeria whose Georgetown page posts service until 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Manny & Olga's official Georgetown location page lists 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Manny & Olga's Pizza Georgetown — Location & Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu 10 a.m.–2 a.m.; Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–3 a.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–2 a.m.

cards.title: Billy Hicks
cards.subtitle: 3277 M St NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Choose the café’s food service for an evening meal on M Street; its official page lists late-night bites and midnight or 1 a.m. closing times.
cards.short_summary: An M Street café and restaurant with posted midnight weekday and 1 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Billy Hicks’ official site lists hours through midnight Monday–Thursday and through 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, alongside a late-night bites menu.
cards.source_title: Billy Hicks — Coffee, Comfort Food, and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–midnight; Fri–Sat 9 a.m.–1 a.m.; Sun 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Service hours may vary.

cards.title: Pinstripes Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1064 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Pair a late dinner with bowling or bocce at this Wisconsin Avenue venue; its location page posts 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant and games venue with food, bowling, and bocce under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Pinstripes’ official Georgetown page lists Friday and Saturday hours of noon–11 p.m.; it identifies bowling, bocce, and Italian-American cuisine at the location.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon 4–10 p.m.; Tue–Wed noon–9 p.m.; Thu noon–10 p.m.; Fri noon–11 p.m.; Sat 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.–8 p.m.

cards.title: Masala Street Eatery
cards.subtitle: 3206 O St NW #1, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use this O Street counter for an evening Indian street-food meal; the business posts 11 p.m. closing times Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown Indian street-food eatery with 11 p.m. service on its open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Masala Street Eatery’s official site lists 4–11 p.m. Tuesday–Friday and noon–11 p.m. Saturday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Masala Street Eatery — Location and Operating Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: closed Monday; Tue–Fri 4–11 p.m.; Sat–Sun noon–11 p.m.

cards.title: Han Palace Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1728 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Plan a group dinner up Wisconsin Avenue, where the restaurant’s official listing posts 10 p.m. closing every day and online ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown Cantonese restaurant with daily 10 p.m. posted closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Han Palace’s official site lists its Georgetown location at 1728 Wisconsin Ave NW and posts hours until 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Han Palace — Georgetown Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted Georgetown hours: Mon–Fri 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sat–Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Guapo's Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 3050 K St NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Go down to K Street for a seated Mexican dinner; the restaurant’s official locations page lists 11 p.m. closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A K Street Mexican restaurant with 11 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Guapo's official locations page lists its Georgetown restaurant at 3050 K St NW, open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Guapo's Cocina & Bar — Georgetown Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted Georgetown hours: Mon–Thu and Sun until 10 p.m.; Fri–Sat until 11 p.m.

cards.title: JINYA Ramen Bar Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1525 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Make this Wisconsin Avenue ramen stop an early late-night dinner; the official location page posts a 10 p.m. close on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown ramen restaurant with Friday and Saturday hours through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: JINYA Ramen Bar’s official Georgetown page lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. at 1525 Wisconsin Avenue NW.
cards.source_title: JINYA Ramen Bar Georgetown — Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu and Sun 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
